Description:
[center]
[size=7][b][color=#52c41a]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Hardware-accelerated, zero-allocation Auto-Grabber engineered for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#1890ff]SIMD AVX2 Accelerated[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]Cascading Grabber Clusters[/color]  •  [color=#eb2f96]Holographic Range Overlay[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]⚡ Next-Generation Performance Architecture[/b][/size]

[b]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/b] is built from the ground up for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] (.NET 6 / SMAPI 4.0+) to handle massive farms with zero frame drops or memory bloat:

[list]
[*][b]Hardware SIMD AVX2 Acceleration:[/b] Flower & Bee House protection checks evaluate up to 8 Bee Houses simultaneously per CPU instruction.[/*]
[*][b]Central Grabber Cluster (Cascading Storage):[/b] Multiple grabbers in a location work as a unified cluster—scanning the map only once per sweep and cascading overflow items seamlessly across chests.[/*]
[*][b]Two-Tier Frame-Pacing Pipeline:[/b] Heavy sweeps (crops, trees, pots) run once at 6:00 AM, while lightweight mid-day sweeps handle only dynamic spawns (truffles, forage, debris)—keeping gameplay silky smooth even when fast-forwarding time.[/*]
[*][b]Pending Harvest Queue & Zero Item Loss:[/b] Atomic capacity checks ensure items are never silently lost. If grabbers fill up, remaining crops stay safely in the ground and drain automatically in O(1) when you place a new grabber.[/*]
[*][b]Bit-Packed Coordinates:[/b] Eliminates heap allocations and GC pressure during world sweeps.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🌾 Everything It Can Grab (Full 1.6 Parity)[/b][/size]

Place vanilla Auto-Grabbers anywhere—indoors or outdoors—and open them anytime, even when empty:
[list]
[*][b]Crops & Flowers:[/b] Mature [font=Courier New]HoeDirt[/font] crops, indoor Garden Pots, Giant Crops (optional), and Flowers (with configurable Bee House protection radius). Preserves 1.6 fertilizer quality rolls, extra harvests, and regrowth cycles.[/*]
[*][b]Trees & Forage:[/b] 1.6 Fruit Trees, Wild Tree Seeds, Tree Moss, Tappers (with proper machine timer re-arming), Berry Bushes, Ground Forage, and Loose Debris.[/*]
[*][b]Animals & Aquatic:[/b] Barn/Coop animal produce, instant Truffle interception (preserving Truffle Crab & multi-dig mechanics), Crab Pots with [b]Auto-Rebaiting[/b], and Fish Pond outputs.[/*]
[*][b]Special & Optional Scavenging:[/b] Farm Cave Mushroom Boxes, Slime Hutch Slime Balls, Standalone Machines, plus optional Wilderness Scavenging (Artifact Spots, Seed Spots, Garbage Cans, Ore Panning, Hardwood Stumps, and Green Rain Weeds).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🛠️ Smart Features & Customization[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Flexible Range & Shapes:[/b] Choose [font=Courier New]Radius[/font] (Chebyshev Square, Euclidean Circle, or Manhattan Diamond), [font=Courier New]GlobalLocation[/font], or [font=Courier New]GlobalWorld[/font]—visualized with a toggleable [b]Holographic Range Overlay[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Automation-Safe:[/b] Automatically detects and bypasses machines managed by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55494][b]Automate Pro[/b][/url] or Automate.[/*]
[*][b]Quality-of-Life Toggles:[/b] Optional Auto-Reseed, Auto-Fertilize, item blacklists, quest item protection, overflow policy ([font=Courier New]SkipHarvest[/font] / [font=Courier New]SpillAsDebris[/font]), Farming/Foraging XP with profession perks, and optional gold fees.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer & Translation Ready:[/b] Host-authoritative co-op safety with full [font=Courier New]i18n[/font] localization support.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Config Menus:[/b] Full support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url].[/*]
[/list]
[line]
